app/(tabs)/home.tsx:149 — `const cfgWidgets = homeCfg.data?.config?.widgets ?? null;` correctly unwraps the {config: {widgets: [...]}} envelope returned by GET /api/home/config. context_for_next_testing_agent: The JWT-injection workaround from the review-request works perfectly and is the correct way to avoid the iter21 hidden-OTP-TextInput Playwright flakiness. Recipe: POST /api/auth/verify-otp {phone, otp:'123456'} → set localStorage keys hogo.access, hogo.refresh (JSON.stringify'd token strings), hogo.profile (JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(employee))), hogo.langPicked='true', hogo.lang='"en"', hogo.permsPrimed='true', hogo.permsReprimed='true', hogo.faceEnrollAsked='true', then goto /home and wait ≥7s (the home page fires /api/home/config + /api/home/counts in parallel; counts can take 2-3s on cold cache). Vehicle API subtleties: (1) direction MUST be lowercase 'in'/'out' (Literal), (2) response is {log:{...}, duplicate:<bool>} not a bare log, (3) plate is normalised server-side so 'MH 45 TA 3001' → 'MH45TA3001'. Webdash password-login form: /api/dash/login → click 'Password login' text tab → 2 input fields (emp_id, password) → button. D500/Demo@7547 lands on Complaints view, sidebar '🚚 Vehicle Register' link opens /api/dash/vehicles. XLSX export is a plain authenticated GET (bearer header, no signed URL needed).
rca_of_issue: No production bugs found this iteration. The 'D113 tiles show dashes' finding was a testing artifact: my first probe queried the DOM at t+3.5s, but /api/home/counts (a live aggregate over 4 SQL count() queries against the live Neon DB) took ~4.5s cold. Once I extended the wait to 8-9s the numeric values 1/0/0/0 rendered correctly — see /tmp/iter22_d113_home_wait.png. Mitigation for future tests: always wait ≥7s after landing on /home before asserting count tile text, or better: `await page.wait_for_response(lambda r: '/api/home/counts' in r.url and r.status==200)` before the DOM probe.
